chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Regarding a man who pledged a house with another man, and it burned down or collapsed, he said: "His wealth remains in the soil of the land."

key_terms.تُرْبَةِ الْأَرْضِ: the soil of the land, meaning the land itself remains
key_terms.دَارًا: a house used here as the pledged asset

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pledged house burns down or collapses?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a mortgaged or pledged house that is destroyed by fire or collapse. It indicates that the value remains tied to the land itself, treating the underlying property basis as the continuing asset.
